existing_root_approved_body_rendering_di: It is natural to wonder whether the conclusions of Theorems~\ref{thm_min} and~\ref{main_mm} still hold without the assumption $\theta^2=\mathrm{id}$. For Theorem~\ref{thm_min}, we do not know, while Theorem~\ref{main_mm} does not hold in general. As a counterexample, consider a Coxeter system $(W,S)$ of type $D_4$, with $S=\{s_0, s_1, s_2, s_3\}$, where $s_0$ is the simple reflection commuting with no other simple reflection. Let $L=\{s_1, s_2, s_3\}$ and let $\theta$ be an automorphism of $(W_L, L)$ acting as a $3$-cycle on $L:=\{s_1, s_2, s_3\}$. Then $W_L^\theta$ has type $A_1$, with generator $s_1 s_2 s_3$. The coset $s_1 W_L^\theta$ has two elements $s_1$ and $s_2 s_3$, hence $s_2 s_3 W_L^\theta \cap \M=\{s_1\}$, but $s_1 \not\leq s_2 s_3$.
